name: Kusano-hime
source:
She/They/Any

Kusano-hime is a goddess who lives in an alternate world that Princess visits sometimes and is her main guide/mentor for her to master her new powers and use them to prevent the end of the world. Her personality is a bit bratty and short-tempered, but they're very intelligent and an expert strategist.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730050/Princess_of_Worlds_End/]Steam[/url]]
